intervention: Input-support intervention: original raw RGB candidate-union mask versus fixed same-chain subset. Identical single-axis TLS algorithm/defaults, complete original base, original five candidate arms, sample spacing, scale, cameras and native added geometry; do not refit patches or tune per-case.
repeat_policy: Two fresh reader-only subprocesses. The exact same original one-per-object DA3 predictions and eight patches are reused. This is not an independent end-to-end reconstruction repeat.
evaluation_policy: Require all 80 normal rows, per-case chain association receipts and every frozen point/patch receipt before accessing complete original object truth. Ten unchanged native arms scored separately without clipping.
qualification: Previously seen synthetic development, not blind, real-capture or G1 qualification. Fixed full sampled image pools and nondegenerate pair-plane seeds, not all noisy assignments. Multiple retained chains are hypotheses, not confirmed target identity. Unknown is not absence. Preserve all empty/rejected/error rows and the complete original GT domain.
